title: planner mints only a single GOAL card — it never decomposes
notes:
OBSERVED 2026-08-20 (twice): `docket-prim planner` writes the /goal contract as ONE card with the done-criteria as checkboxes, and no TASK/GUARD/TEST breakdown. The human expects a real task list; they get one card and have to hand-decompose. This has now happened on two separate plans and both times the human reacted with 'one fucking task AGAIN'.

EXPECTED: the planner emits a GOAL plus a first pass of TASK cards (one per 'done-when'), each with a TEST child, plus GUARD cards from the --negative flags. The done-criteria are already the task seeds — they should become cards, not checkboxes on a single card.

FIX: in the planner, fan each done-criterion into a TASK (+auto TEST like task-create does), and each --negative into a GUARD, all parented to the GOAL.

title: planner does not run or require the interview — an agent skips requirements-gathering
notes:
OBSERVED 2026-08-20: `docket-prim planner --help` says '/plandocket gathers and calls this', i.e. an interview is meant to PRECEDE the planner. But the planner CLI accepts raw --goal/--done flags with no interview, so an agent hand-writes a shallow goal from its own summary and skips gathering the human's actual requirements. Nothing forces or even nudges the interview.

EXPECTED: either the planner refuses to mint without an interview transcript / PlanRequest that carries interview provenance, or it prints a loud warning and a pointer to run /plandocket first. At minimum the minted pack should record whether it came from an interview or from raw flags, so a flag-only plan is visibly un-interviewed.

FIX: add an interview gate (or provenance field) to PlanRequest; warn on flag-only invocation.

title: planner creates zero milestones
notes:
OBSERVED 2026-08-20: a planner-minted pack has milestones.jsonl empty — a GOAL and (after hand-decomposition) tasks, but no milestones grouping them. A plan with 7+ tasks and no milestone structure is flat and hard to sequence.

EXPECTED: the planner emits at least one milestone (or one per phase) and assigns the generated TASK cards to it, so the pack has GOAL -> milestone(s) -> tasks.

FIX: in the planner, create a default milestone from the goal (or group done-criteria into phases) and set each TASK's milestone.

title: planner builds no parent hierarchy (goal->milestone->task)
notes:
OBSERVED 2026-08-20: even with milestones added, nothing is parented. Generated TASK cards parent straight to the GOAL (or to nothing).

CORRECT MODEL (not goal->milestone->task): milestone is an overlay, not a parent. Nesting is parent only: GOAL	o none|GOAL; PLAN	o GOAL|PLAN; TASK	o GOAL|PLAN|TASK; GUARD	o GOAL|PLAN|TASK (required, leaf); TEST	o TASK (required, leaf). Tag milestone: MS-* on the card. Never parent a card to MS-*. Never nest under GUARD or TEST.

EXPECTED: GOAL tree via parent; tasks tag a milestone; TESTs parent their TASK. Relates to 'planner creates zero milestones' (still emit MS-* rows and set the overlay field).

title: Validate + SPEC + interview encode allowed nesting (milestone is overlay)
notes: Daniel 2026-08-20: lock what may nest. SPEC table + CheckNest: GOAL under none|GOAL; PLAN under GOAL|PLAN; TASK under GOAL|PLAN|TASK; GUARD under GOAL|PLAN|TASK required leaf; TEST under TASK required leaf. Forbidden: nest under GUARD/TEST; TEST under GOAL/PLAN; PLAN under TASK; parent of MS-*. Interview Q4/Q5 and plandocket skill updated. Planner empty-tasks path fails (single GOAL is the muzzle). Blind reviewer (TASK-0005) still To Do — its hierarchy classes must match this table, not goal->milestone->task.

title: planner spawns a blind reviewer that checks the JSONL against 50+ problem classes
notes:
Daniel 2026-08-20: after the planner mints/decomposes a pack, a BLIND subagent (no planner context) should review the new tasks.jsonl + milestones.jsonl against AT LEAST 50 kinds of problems, then report findings back to the planner agent — which fixes them before handing the pack to the human.

The 50+ classes span: schema (malformed json, missing/duplicate/bad ids, bad status/priority/type), referential integrity (dangling parent/subtask/milestone refs, orphans, cycles, bidirectional parent<->subtasks mismatch, tests not parented to tasks), hierarchy (multiple/zero GOAL, milestone not parented to goal, tasks parented flat to goal, milestone with no tasks, closed-with-open, done-with-open-tests), content quality (vague/duplicate/overlong titles, empty criteria, non-falsifiable tests, implementation-not-outcome criteria, contradictory/duplicate criteria, placeholders, status/notes disagreement, blocked-without-reason), dates (missing/malformed/future/updated-before-created), and safety (secrets/PII in notes, non-portable absolute paths, encoding glitches).

This exists because the planner itself keeps shipping broken packs (one-card goals, no decomposition, no milestones, no parenting — see the other planner bugs). A blind review loop catches those before the human sees them. Blind = fresh agent judging only the files, so it can't rationalize the planner's output.

First checklist prompt was run by hand 2026-08-20 against docket-declutter.prim; make it a built-in step.

title: VALIDATION cards close parents that have children
requirements: Every GOAL, PLAN, or TASK with GOAL/PLAN/TASK children has a VALIDATION child.
Parent cannot be Done until its VALIDATION is Done; VALIDATION cannot be Done while a work sibling is open.
test-cases: Validate a pack where a GOAL has a TASK child and no VALIDATION; schema reports no-validation close-out.
acceptance-criteria: A stranger sees VALIDATION in the type list and cannot mark a decomposed parent Done from the editor or CLI until the close-out card is Done.
SPEC, review questions, and plandocket interview name VALIDATION as distinct from TEST, including one per depth.
notes: Daniel 2026-08-20: any tree that breaks into smaller tasks needs a validation card to close the parent. That is not a TEST. TEST proves one TASK. VALIDATION is how the system closes a GOAL, PLAN, or TASK that has work children. A four-deep tree has four VALIDATION cards. Slower, more automated. Work siblings Done, then VALIDATION Done, then the parent Done. Completing children is not closing the parent.

title: Deterministic quantitative plan score
requirements: docket-prim score prints 0-100 from pack shape only, with named deductions
Missing GOAL, GUARD, VALIDATION close-out, orphans, cycles, and a flat tree each deduct a fixed number of points
test-cases: Score a 20-TASK no-tree pack and get 0; score a GOAL-PLAN-TASK-GUARD-TEST-VALIDATION tree with a milestone and get 100
Calling ScoreOf twice on the same pack returns identical JSON
acceptance-criteria: A stranger can rerun docket-prim score --json and match the number without a model
validate still reports hollow notes; the plan score does not use note meaning
notes: Daniel 2026-08-20: we need a deterministic plan score, merely quantitative. It notices how many things do not make sense: lack of one VALIDATION per decomposing node, orphans, no guards, no goals, no milestones, no proper DAG. docket-prim score is 0-100 from graph shape only. House pack scores 0. A GOAL-PLAN-TASK-GUARD-TEST-VALIDATION tree with a milestone scores 100. Same JSON twice. Hollow notes still fail validate and do not move the number. Editor rail shows N/100 plan. Proven: go test ./internal/docket ./internal/editor, CLI on docket.prim, GET /api/state on the boot-graph editor, .proof/plan-score.png.

title: Search matches every field on the card
requirements: Editor search matches any jsonl field on the visible card, not a cherry-picked list
docket-prim task-search uses the same whole-card blob so tags, parent, blocked_reason, and dates hit
test-cases: Search blocked_reason text in the editor and see the card; page source contains cardBlob or JSON.stringify(t) inside visible
Pack.Search on a tag that is not in the title returns that card
acceptance-criteria: A stranger can type a tag, a parent id, or a start date and get the card
Title-only search still works
notes: Daniel 2026-08-20: search needs to work across all data in the card. The editor box and task-search only walked id, uid, title, notes, type, requirements, test-cases, and acceptance. Tags, parent, status, blocked_reason, dates, dependencies, assignees, and milestone never hit. Search the whole jsonl record. Same pack, same match in CLI and editor.

title: Gantt hover tip must fully hide on leave
requirements: Leaving a Gantt row hides #gantt-tip with display none, not an empty bordered box
The tip element is not styled by the left-rail aside rule
test-cases: Hover a Gantt bar, move off it, and #gantt-tip is hidden with a zero box
Page source contains #gantt-tip[hidden] display none
acceptance-criteria: A stranger leaving a Gantt row sees no leftover tooltip chrome
Hover still shows the intel card
notes: Daniel 2026-08-20: the blur in gantt does not get rid of the box fully it just empties it. Leave-row clears innerHTML but the chrome stays because #gantt-tip is an aside, so the rail aside { display: flex } beats the hidden attribute. The empty 360px padded box remains. Hide must display none the whole tip, not only its text.

requirements: Leaving a Gantt row hides #gantt-tip with display none, not an empty bordered box

Page source contains #gantt-tip[hidden] display none

Hover still shows the intel card
notes: Daniel 2026-08-20: the blur in gantt does not get rid of the box fully it just empties it. Cause: #gantt-tip was an aside, so rail aside { display:flex } beat the hidden attribute and left a 360px empty chrome. Tip is now a div with #gantt-tip[hidden], #gantt-tip:empty { display:none !important }. Proven: hover display block 360x156, leave display none 0x0 (.proof/gantt-tip-hover.png, .proof/gantt-tip-gone.png).

title: CLI lift raises plan score with nest-legal patches
requirements: docket-prim lift --dry-run prints before and after scores and the ops without appending jsonl
docket-prim lift mints VALIDATION and TEST cards via the CLI so a decomposing tree with tesless TASKs scores higher
test-cases: Dry-run on a GOAL plus TASK pack shows after > before and tasks.jsonl line count unchanged
Apply lift on a GOAL plus TASK pack; ScoreOf rises and the new rows have uids
acceptance-criteria: A stranger can raise the graph score without printf to jsonl
Orphan GUARDs and loose work stay put unless --attach-guards or --attach-loose names a parent
notes: Daniel 2026-08-20: you will need a method within the CLI to get the score up. score only diagnoses. lift applies deterministic graph patches through CreateTask and EditTask: VALIDATION close-out, TEST children, optional GUARD mint, optional attach-guards and attach-loose. Dry-run prints the projected score and does not write jsonl. It does not invent a GOAL or guess among many milestones.
